ctx.x: Bert Corvello, music major from Mills. Worked at the telephone company. She said, “They will never give a jazz musician, or even maybe a musician, a phone. You’ll be last on the list, and the list is long. Put down ‘teacher’.”
This was shortly after World War II, and there really was a priority list about who got a telephone.
